issues_detected.description: The October 2025 and June 2026 resource descriptions state each release 'includes perturb-seq data for MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells with and without treatment', yet their file_collections list only KOLF2 perturb-seq archives (cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip, cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip) and external_resources records 'perturb-seq data in MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells with and without treatment' as 'marked Embargoed rather than resolving to a repository'
issues_detected.recommendation: Qualify the release descriptions so that MDA-MB-468 perturb-seq is stated as embargoed/external rather than included, or explain that the release-record text lists it despite the embargo

issues_detected.description: external_resources entries for 'MassIVE Repository', 'NCBI BioProject' and 'Figshare' carry repository names only; the record itself notes 'The captured release pages give the link text but no MassIVE accession identifiers' and the same for BioProject and Figshare, so none of the external raw-data deposits is resolvable from this record
issues_detected.recommendation: Add MassIVE (MSV...), BioProject (PRJNA...) and Figshare accession identifiers or URLs when they can be sourced

issues_detected.description: No top-level 'doi' or 'version' slot: id is 'https://cm4ai.org/' and the persistent identifiers exist only in citation, version_access.latest_version_doi and the four resources; the programme-level referent is a deliberate choice recorded in source_caveats, but a consumer reading top-level fields alone finds no DOI
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate doi with the latest release DOI (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C) and version with its version, or state explicitly that the programme-level record has no single DOI

issues_detected.description: related_datasets uses relationship_type 'is_described_by' with target_dataset values that are publication DOIs (bioRxiv preprints), so publications are encoded as related datasets; the only dataset-to-dataset relation is 'has_version' to doi:10.18130/V3/DXWOS5, while the four enumerated releases are modelled as resources rather than typed relations
issues_detected.recommendation: Keep publications under citation/external_resources and reserve related_datasets for dataset-to-dataset relations, or add typed relations among the four release DOIs

issues_detected.description: cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip is described as 'Raw sequence data from the expressed genome-scale CRISPRi Perturbation Cell Atlas' but is listed at 79.6 KB (October 2025) and 73.3 KB (June 2026), implausibly small for raw single-cell reads; the record reproduces the source description without noting the discrepancy
issues_detected.recommendation: Note that the archive likely holds SRA submission metadata or pointers rather than reads

issues_detected.description: No 'variables', 'is_tabular' or 'anomalies' slot; the SEC-MS, AP-MS and perturbation atlas archives contain tabular products whose column structures are undescribed, and the metadata defects the record does catch (an untreated archive described as 'MDA-MB-468 treated', inherited trailing dates, 'the DRAFT version was not found') live only in source_caveats
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variable-level metadata for the tabular products and an anomalies entry that surfaces the source-record defects already noted in source_caveats

issues_detected.description: ethical_reviews names two contacts and the Value-Sensitive Design methodology but does not address conflicts of interest; informed_consent, at_risk_populations and participant_compensation slots are absent, with non-applicability derivable only from human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects=false and 'both cell lines have been ethically sourced'
issues_detected.recommendation: State whether conflicts of interest were assessed and explicitly negate consent, compensation and at-risk-population applicability with the cell-line rationale

issues_detected.description: The file header states '# Generated: 2026-08-26' while the run label is 2026-08-24; the header and label disagree on the generation date
issues_detected.recommendation: Confirm which date is correct and align the header with the provenance record

semantic_insights: All persistent identifiers use the University of Virginia Dataverse prefix 10.18130 (B35XWX, F3TD5R, K7TGEM, HIGT4C, DXWOS5), consistent with publisher 'https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/' and the LibraData maintainer entry

NIH grant identifiers are format-valid: 1OT2OD032742-01, supplement 3OT2OD032742-01S2 (with RePORTER application 11211616, FY2025 amount 5,289,382 USD, period 2022-09-01 to 2026-08-31) and 5U54HG012513-02 correctly scoped as Bridge Center funding; the project-end conflict (2026-08-31 vs 'November 2026') is recorded in source_caveats item (4)

Cell line RRIDs (RRID:CVCL_0419 for MDA-MB-468, RRID:CVCL_B5P3 for KOLF2.1J) are valid Cellosaurus format and match the named lines; ORCID CURIEs are used for governance and ethics contacts with the identification reasoning stated

human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects=false is consistently propagated through is_deidentified, confidential_elements, sensitive_elements and regulatory_restrictions, and ethical_reviews states 'No institutional review board approval is claimed by any source in the bundle'

Instance counts are correctly scoped: 53,788 images, 1,374 interactions and 7,023 proteins are attributed to 'the CM4AI web portal and data releases page ... for the project as a whole', and the AP-MS instance explicitly asserts no count; the 21.4 TB volume is not converted to bytes because it 'would assert precision the sources do not carry'

Temporal ordering is coherent and staged file publication after release dates (Oct 22 2025 for June 2025 images, Dec 22 2025 for October 2025 SRA/metadata, Jul 15 2026 for June 2026 images) is documented per release, with the identical Data Creation Date 2025-02-27 across all deposits correctly excluded as a collection date

Seven numbered source conflicts are resolved by a declared tier ranking, including the 2025-vs-2026 release date, the 464/523/563 protein-count disagreement, the Sali affiliation, the governance-body name and the perturb-seq gene counts; the Nature 2025 U2OS article is identified as a distinct dataset whose facts 'were therefore not merged into this record'

Ontology-coded data topics on instances (GO_0008104, NCIT_C18469, EFO_0008860, BAO_0002603) are semantically appropriate for protein localization, protein-protein interaction, CRISPR screen and AP-MS respectively

Every distributed archive across the four releases carries an MD5 checksum, and the record uses checksums to establish that the June 2026 image archives are 'distinct files' despite identical names and sizes

sub_elements.name: Related Datasets with Typed Relationships
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: has_version doi:10.18130/V3/DXWOS5 (V1 release cited in the preprint), is_described_by doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311 and doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734
sub_elements.quality_note: Typed relations present; two of three targets are publications and the four enumerated releases are related only implicitly via resources (flagged low-severity)

strengths: Verified-identifier density: five UVA Dataverse DOIs (10.18130 prefix) consistent with the publisher, format-valid NIH award numbers with RePORTER-level detail, valid Cellosaurus RRIDs for both cell lines, ORCID CURIEs for governance and ethics contacts, and ontology-coded data topics on every counted instance

Programme-level referent handled coherently: four releases enumerated as resources with per-release version, DOI, file counts, staged publication dates and MD5 checksums, and the 21.4 TB volume and file totals deliberately left unconverted where the sources do not support precision

Consistent no-human-subjects reasoning: involves_human_subjects=false is propagated through is_deidentified, confidential_elements, sensitive_elements and regulatory_restrictions, with the explicit statement that no IRB approval is claimed by any source

Systematic source-conflict transparency: seven numbered disagreements resolved by a declared tier ranking (release date, protein counts, institutions, project end, governance body name, Sali affiliation, perturb-seq gene counts), two contact identifications made explicit, and the U2OS Nature paper excluded as a distinct dataset

Complete provenance and maintenance story: quarterly updates through November 2026, a concrete erratum for the June 2025 revision, raw-vs-packaged separation across laboratory archives, SRA, MassIVE and image ZIPs, and FAIRSCAPE/EVI provenance graphs enumerated per release
weaknesses: No variable-level metadata and no is_tabular flag: the column structures of the SEC-MS, AP-MS and perturbation-atlas archives are undescribed (costs Elements 3.4 and 5.3)
No anomalies documentation: source-record defects are caught in source_caveats but not surfaced as anomalies, and no data-level outlier or batch-effect information is recorded (costs Element 9.3)

Internal tension on MDA-MB-468 perturb-seq: the October 2025 and June 2026 resource descriptions state the release includes it while file_collections list only KOLF2 archives and external_resources marks it Embargoed
External raw-data deposits (MassIVE, NCBI BioProject, Figshare) are named without accession identifiers or URLs, and the MuSIC/cellmaps pipeline has no repository link or version

Top-level doi and version slots are absent for the programme record; consent, compensation and at-risk-population non-applicability is implicit; conflicts of interest are not addressed; the header generation date (2026-08-26) disagrees with the run label (2026-08-24)
recommendations: Add a 'variables' section (or is_tabular plus a pointer to the JSON-Schema descriptions inside the RO-Crate packages) describing the column structure of the tabular archives
Reconcile the MDA-MB-468 perturb-seq claim in the October 2025 and June 2026 resource descriptions with the embargo recorded in external_resources
Add an anomalies entry that surfaces the source-record defects already noted in source_caveats and any known QC outcomes, outliers or batch effects
Add MassIVE, BioProject and Figshare accession identifiers and a repository URL and version for the MuSIC/cellmaps pipeline when they can be sourced

Populate top-level doi and version (or state why the programme record has none), explicitly negate consent/compensation/at-risk applicability with the cell-line rationale, state whether conflicts of interest were assessed, and align the header generation date with the run label
